entities.summary: Curt Badinski was a German general in the Wehrmacht during World War II who held several divisional commands. He reached the rank of Generalleutnant and was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany. Badinski was captured by British forces in August 1944 in the Falaise Pocket.
